page_data.en:
TRANSLATION

Despatch No.4611

The following letter No.75 from the Election Office
of the Shanghai Municipality Representatives to the
National People's Congress was handed over to me by
the Acting Mayor :-

"July 18 has been approved as the date to cast
ballots for the election of the Shanghai representatives
to the National People's Congress. Several polling
booths have been established in the International
Settlement and in the French Concession. Fearing that
the Police of the Settlement and French Concession
may misunderstand the purpose of these polling booths,
we send you this letter with a request that the Police
Departments of the Shanghai Municipal Council and the
French Municipal Council be notified of the purpose
of the polling stations. Lists of the addresses of
the polling stations are enclosed herewith."

I have been instructed to comply with this request,
and am sending this letter together with a list of
the addresses of the polling stations in the Settlement
and in the French Concession for your information.

(Signed) Chow Tung-kan
Acting Chief Secretary of the
Shanghai City Government.

Enclosure:
A list of the addresses of
the polling stations.

To the Shanghai Municipal Council.

Date July 12, 1937.

第4611号公函

上海市出席国民大会代表选举办公室发出的下列第75号信函，由代理市长移交予我：-

“已核准7月18日为选举出席国民大会之上海代表的投票日期。在国际公共租界及法租界内已设立若干投票站。鉴于担心租界巡捕及法租界巡捕可能误解这些投票站的用途，特致此函，恳请通知上海工部局警务处及法国公董局警务处关于投票站的用途。随函附上投票站地址清单。”

我已奉命遵照此项请求办理，现随函附上租界及法租界内投票站地址清单一份，供贵方知悉。

（签名）周同干（Chow Tung-kan）
上海市政府代理秘书长。

附件：
投票站地址清单。

致上海工部局。

Race Renascence Association - inaugural meeting postponed

The inaugural meeting of the Race Renascence Association,
promoted by the China Literature and Art Society, with an
office at Room 631 Continental Emporium Building, Nanking,
which was scheduled to be held at 2 p.m. July 24 in the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, has been postponed to 3 p.m.
July 28 at the same venue.

Shanghai delegates to the National People's Congress -
elected

Twenty Shanghai delegates to the National People's
Congress, four of them representing labour unions, four
trade associations, four peasants and the remaining eight
the people not represented by the above associations, have
been elected as a result of the ballots cast on July 18.
The delegates include Mr. Wong Shiao-lai and Mr. Yu Ya-ching
for the trade associations, Mr. Loh Ching-dz and Mr. Chu
Hsueh-fan for the labour unions, Mr. Ling Kong-hou and Mr.
Yu Tseng-hwei (俞振輝) for the peasants and Messrs
Tu Yueh-sung, T. L. Soong and Dao Pah-chuen for the people
not represented by the above associations.

种族复兴协会 - 成立大会延期

由中国文艺协会发起、办事处设在南京大陆商场大楼631室的种族复兴协会，原定于7月24日下午2时在总商会举行的成立大会，已延期至7月28日下午3时在同一地点举行。

出席国民大会之上海代表 - 已选出

经过7月18日的投票，选出了二十名出席国民大会的上海代表，其中四名代表工会，四名代表同业公会，四名代表农民，其余八名代表未被上述协会涵盖的民众。代表包括代表同业公会的黄孝来（Wong Shiao-lai）先生和虞洽卿（Yu Ya-ching）先生，代表工会的罗精笃（Loh Ching-dz）先生和朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan）先生，代表农民的凌孔侯（Ling Kong-hou）先生和俞振辉（Yu Tseng-hwei）先生，以及代表未被上述协会涵盖民众的杜月笙（Tu Yueh-sung）、宋子良（T. L. Soong）和陶百川（Dao Pah-chuen）先生。

On July 17, pictures of candidates for election to

organizes enemy-resisting and Chinese troops support
committee

Under the auspices of the Chung Hwa Seamen's Special

representatives of various local seamen's organizations was
held at 9 a.m. July 17 in the Kuomintang Headquarters, 680

為選舉國民大會代表
介紹給公民的一點意見

國民大會最重大的任務，是制定憲法，奠定國家的基礎，參加國民大會的代表，所負的使命是何
等重大！因之我們對於這回選舉代表，不能不特別的慎重。
至少要合乎下列的幾個標準，才可以當我們的代表——
對國家——
要公忠為國
要賢良方正
要誠摯廉明
對社會——
要熱心公益
要切實為市民謀福利
不是我們的標準要特別提高，因為當此國難嚴重的時候，出席的代表，目前就要負起救國的責任
來以拯救四萬萬五千萬的人民。
我們所知道可以合乎我們上面的標準的是——
杜月笙先生 宋子良先生
錢新之先生 郭順先生
金廷蓀先生 林康侯先生
虞洽卿先生 王曉籟先生
上面的幾位先生過去在商界金融界都有很大的功績表現，是早為上海市民深深的認識！
總理所付予之民權，開始在此實驗了，希望大家不要隨便放棄，果然是代表的責任重大，而參加
選舉者的責任尤其重大！

beginning from 7.7.37. Attention is respectfully drawn
to lantern slide No.3 which reads "The National Congress
is to consolidate China's strength against outsiders."
Instructions are solicited as to what action should
be taken in regard to these slides.
The undersigned advised Messrs. Chang and Chao that
whatever decision is reached in the matter would be communicated
to them on the morning of 7.7.37, through Supt. Tan Shiao-liang
who is in possession of their telephone number.

事由 上海特区国民党总部执行委员会申请许可放映10张带有宣传支持国民大会选举标语的幻灯片。
由 D.S.I. Logan 制作并转发。

1937年7月6日下午2时30分，上海特区国民党总部执行委员会的张汉云先生和赵闰身先生携带10张带有全心全意支持国民大会选举标语的幻灯片（译文附后）来到本办公室，提交审查，以期获得自1937年7月7日起在公共租界各电影院放映的许可。谨提请注意第3号幻灯片，其内容为“国民大会旨在巩固中国力量以抵御外人”。请示应对这些幻灯片采取何种行动。
签署人告知张、赵两位先生，无论对此事作出何种决定，均将于1937年7月7日上午通过掌握其电话号码的谭绍良警司传达给他们。

DBR
6/7

W. Logan
D. S. I.

D. C. (特别支部). S3. α S2
除第3号未获批准外，其余无异议。关于幻灯片及类似宣传品的一般政策是予以禁止，除非材料正式且政府官员对宣传及自称“中立”的协会等应更为谨慎。然而，每项申请均可给予适当考虑。

（印章：特别支部 - 1937年7月7日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

page_data.en:
Translation of 10 lantern slides submitted by the Executive
Committee of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang
Headquarters.

(1) The National Congress is the important step from the
fixed constitution towards the constitutional administration.
We should unanimously participate in the election.

(2) The National Congress is to secure the joint unification
of the Chinese nationals. We should unanimously
participate in the election.

(3) The National Congress is to consolidate China's
strength against outsiders. We should unanimously
participate in the election.

(4) The National Congress is to concentrate capable elements
and to undertake the resuscitation of the race.
We should unanimously participate in the election.

(5) The fixed constitution is an assurance of the social
benefits and of modern improvements.
We should unanimously participate in the election.

(6) The fixed constitution will turn the Republic of China
into a lawful nation under the Three Peoples Principles.
We should unanimously participate in the election.

(7) To convene the National Congress is the prelude of
the people to exercise the four rights.
We should unanimously participate in the election.

(8) We should undertand the importance of the National
Congress. We should unanimously participate in the
election.

(9) We should elect elegibles of high personality and
who are interested in public welfare to be our
representatives. We should unanimously participate in
the election.

(10) We should elect elegibles who have good knowledge
of education and experience to be our representatives.
We should unanimously participate in the election.
page_data.zh:
上海特区国民党总部执行委员会提交的10张幻灯片译文。

(1) 国民大会是从固定宪法走向宪政的重要步骤。我们应一致参加选举。

(2) 国民大会旨在确保中国国民的共同统一。我们应一致参加选举。

(3) 国民大会旨在巩固中国力量以抵御外人。我们应一致参加选举。

(4) 国民大会旨在集中优秀人才，承担民族复兴的重任。我们应一致参加选举。

(5) 固定宪法是社会福利和现代进步的保障。我们应一致参加选举。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Tuesday, May 25, 1937 21991
Chinese To Vote
In First Major
Poll Of History

Citizens Pick
Out Delegates
To Big Congress

Session Will Discuss
New Constitution
For China

MANY CANDIDATES
ALREADY CHOSEN

Voting Slated On July
20, 21, 22; Results
Due August 15

CHINESE who have their citizenship duly registered will go to the polls on July 20, 21 and 22 in the first major election in the history of this country to pick the 1200 delegates for the National People's Congress to be held in the spacious new building in Nanking on November 12 for the important task of discussing and approving the constitution.

In all, 1700 persons will take part in the Congress. In addition to the 1200 elected delegates, the 260 members of the Central Executive Committee and Central Supervisory Committee of the Kuomintang will be ex-officio delegates. Two hundred and forty persons will also be present in the capacity of appointed delegates.

Candidates for the elections have already been chosen in many cities and provinces while in others, the preliminary elections have yet to be held. Work in Hopei, Chahar, Kwangsi and several other provinces is understood to be progressing slowly and it is doubtful if the elections may take place on time there.

Results of the elections will be pronounced before August 15 and the elected delegates should be notified of the election before that date, the National Government has ordered.

To Set Date
In order to avoid a possible delay of the Congress, the National Government has also ordered that all preliminary elections for the candidates to run for the major election this July be completed before the end of this month.

In addition to the study and approval of the constitution, which was last drafted by the Legislative Yuan after a prolonged deliberation on the basis of the first draft accomplished by Dr. John C. H. Wu, prominent jurist and member of the Legislative Yuan, the Congress will also set a date for the enforcement of the constitution.

Congress Postponed
The Congress was originally scheduled to be held on November 12, last year, but unavoidably postponed for a year because of the stupendous work involved in registration of citizens and the preliminary elections.

November 12 was picked as the date of the Congress because it marks the birth anniversary of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen, founder of the Chinese republic.

中国人将在历史上
首次重大投票中
行使投票权

出席大型大会的
代表

会议将讨论
中国的新
宪法

许多候选人
已获选定

投票定于7月
20、21、22日进行；结果
预计于8月15日公布

 duly registered citizenship 的中国公民将于7月20、21和22日前往投票站，参加该国历史上的首次重大选举，选出1200名国民大会代表。国民大会将于11月12日在南京宽敞的新大楼举行，其重要任务是讨论和批准宪法。

总计将有1700人参加大会。除1200名当选代表外，国民党中央执行委员会和中央监察委员会的260名成员将成为当然代表。另有240人将以指派代表的身份出席。

许多省市的选举候选人已经选定，而在其他地区，初选尚未举行。据悉，河北、察哈尔、广西及其他几个省份的工作进展缓慢，那里的选举能否按时举行尚存疑问。

国民政府已下令，选举结果须在8月15日前公布，当选代表须在该日期前收到当选通知。

确定日期
为避免大会可能出现的延误，国民政府还下令，所有为参加今年7月大选而进行的候选人初选工作须在本月底前完成。

除了研究和批准宪法外——该宪法草案由著名法学家、立法院议员吴经熊博士完成初稿后，经立法院长时间审议最后起草——大会还将确定宪法实施的日期。

大会延期
大会原定于去年11月12日举行，但因公民登记和初选工作量巨大，不得不推迟一年。

选择11月12日作为大会日期，是因为这一天是中华民国创始人孙中山博士的诞辰纪念日。

归档

Subject Chinese Students National Salvation Federation requesting the
Central Political Council to permit the students to have seats in the
National People's Conference.
Made by D.I. Pan Iien-pih. Forwarded by C Crawford 2J

The Chinese Students National Salvation Federation has
submitted an appeal to the Central Political Council, Nanking,
requesting the latter to permit the students to have 34 seats
in the coming National People's Conference to be held on
November 12, 1937. The delegates will be elected from amongst
the students of the 34 provinces of China, each province to
have one representative.

The Federation has devised the following rules governing
the tasks to be performed by students in various farming villages
during the summer vacation, between 15.7.37 and 15.9.37, and has
distributed them to its branches in various places:-

1. The students should go to villages in the interior and
explain to the natives the present political situation -
aggression on China by Japan, and the dangerous situation in
North China. At the same time they should promote education
in the villages with the object of leading the masses to
join the anti-Japanese front.

2. The students should make known to the people the importance
of the National People's Conference and how it will affect
the fate of the country. They should also show to the people
the points in the regulations governing election of delegates
to the Conference which are not in conformity with democracy
and exhort them to demand real democratic People's Conference.

3. The students should organize "Corps to console soldiers"
with the object of encouraging the soldiers and transforming
them into strong anti-Japanese units. The corps should
prepare and present fans, shirts etc., inscribed with national
salvation slogans to the soldiers.

4. Japan is poisoning the people in North China with narcotics.

Journal de Shanghai

FORECAST OF THE ELECTIONS OF PEOPLE'S REPRESENTATIVES
(From our Special Correspondent)

Nanking, September 11.

Certain reflections made by foreign and Chinese newspapers on the abuses and irregularities in the preliminary elections of people's representatives have attracted the attention of the Chinese Government. Yesterday an official decree was issued strictly prohibiting election agents or the candidates themselves from giving too elaborate entertainments.

According to election experts, candidates will have to spend more than $5,000 each for dinners and other entertainments in order to be assured of a sufficient number of votes.

The lists of the persons first elected are submitted to the various Municipal or Provincial Elections Control Committees which will ratify the election of about a dozen of the persons first elected. The persons whose election had been ratified will eventually vote for the election of representatives to the future National Assembly of the People. For a person's election to secure ratification he - must be persona grata, first of all, with the election of supervisors, then with the central authorities whose duty is to examine the lists of persons first elected. These elections are always influenced by the political factions actually in power.

One can now easily understand why the position of representative of the people is being so keenly contested by the various political parties, for 50% of the representatives will be the future Ministers of State or members of the Legislative and Control Yuan; they may also be appointed to important posts in the provinces or municipalities, and even in the army or navy. Finally, it is they who will elect the President and Vice President of the Republic, the Presidents of the Legislative, the Control and the Examination Yuans and 50% of the members of the two first-named Yuans.

To make his election definite, a candidate must possess a sufficiently large fortune or he must have a certain amount of influence over the persons first elected; he must be sufficiently known to the election supervisors to assure a ratification of his preliminary election; lastly, he must belong to a sufficiently powerful political faction.

Certain Chinese circles have made the following interesting forecast of the results of the elections:

1. Government Parties

(a) The Ching Sae Hui Political Party.--- The leaders are Generals Li Keng Yuan, Huang Fu, Yang Yung Tai, Hsiung Shih Hwei, Wu Teh Chen, the Ministers Chang Kung Chuan, Wu Ting Chang etc. They control five of the Yangtze Provinces. This Party will probably win 400 seats in the elections.

《字林西报》

人民代表选举预测
（发自本报特约通讯员）

南京，9月11日。

中外报纸对人民代表初选中的舞弊和违规行为所作的某些评论，已引起中国政府的注意。昨日颁布官方命令，严格禁止选举代理人或候选人本人举办过于铺张的宴请活动。

据选举专家称，候选人每人需在晚宴和其他娱乐活动上花费超过5,000美元，以确保获得足够的票数。

初选当选人名单提交给各市或省选举监督委员会，这些委员会将批准约十几名初选当选人的资格。获得批准的人最终将投票选举未来国民大会的代表。一个人的选举要获得批准，首先必须在选举监督员眼中是受欢迎的人，其次在负责审查初选当选人名单的中央当局眼中也是如此。这些选举总是受到实际掌权的政治派系的影响。

人们现在不难理解为何各政党如此激烈地争夺人民代表席位，因为50%的代表将成为未来的国务部长或立法院和监察院委员；他们也可能被任命为省或市的重要职务，甚至军队或海军中的重要职务。最后，正是他们将选举共和国总统和副总统，立法院、监察院和考试院院长，以及前两个院50%的成员。

为了确保当选，候选人必须拥有足够庞大的财富，或者对初选当选人具有一定的影响力；他必须为选举监督员所熟知，以确保其初选结果获得批准；最后，他必须属于一个足够强大的政治派系。

中国某些圈子对选举结果做出了以下有趣的预测：

August 14, 1936.    Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

ELECTION OF REPRESENTATIVES TO NATIONAL PEOPLE'S CONGRESS

The registration of citizens for election as Shanghai representatives to the National People's Congress to be held on November 12 this year at Nanking will commence to-day.
On August 12, the local Tangpu distributed copies of a notice calling upon Chinese citizens in this locality to register with the Citizens Registration Office for the election of Shanghai representatives to the National People's Congress.
The Election Office of the Shanghai Representatives to the National People's Congress is carrying out the work of investigations and registration of citizens. As to the work of investigations of citizens in the French Concession, the Election Office has assigned the 2nd District Kuomintang Branch to undertake the work.
An investigation of citizens in the French Concession was started on August 10. A notice to that effect was sent in advance to the French Consul-General and the French Municipal Council. On August 12, when the 2nd District Kuomintang Branch was carrying on the work of registration of citizens, the French authorities detailed a party of detectives to stop the registration, on the ground that approval had not been obtained from the French authorities. The detectives wanted to take the registrars to the Police Station, but they refrained after an explanation was given. The detectives took away some of the registration forms and instructed that the work of registration must cease.
On the afternoon of the same day, the Election Office opened negotiations with the French Municipal Council. In the meantime, a certain prominent person in the French Concession gave to the French Consul-General an explanation of the registration. Later, the French authorities acknowledged that a misunderstanding had taken place. On the evening of August 12, the copies of the registration form taken to the Police Station were returned to the Election Office. The French authorities have indicated that they will not interfere in future and promised to render assistance to the work.
On August 13, the registration of citizens in the French Concession was resumed.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE TRAINING OF CITIZENS

In order to render assistance to the Government in the work of training citizens in the Foreign Settlements, the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation has formed a Citizens Training Committee and eleven members of the Committee have been elected.
Numerous residents have applied to the Training Committee to undergo training.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

国民大会代表选举

定于今年11月12日在南京举行的上海市出席国民大会代表选举的公民登记工作于今日开始。
8月12日，本地党部分发了通知副本，呼吁本地中国公民向上海市出席国民大会代表选举公民登记处进行登记。
上海市出席国民大会代表选举办事处正在进行公民调查及登记工作。关于法租界内的公民调查工作，选举办事处已指派国民党第二区党部承担此项工作。
法租界内的公民调查于8月10日开始。事先已向法国总领事及公董局发送了相关通知。8月12日，当国民党第二区党部进行公民登记工作时，法国当局以未获法方批准为由，派遣一批侦探阻止登记。侦探欲将登记员带往警察局，但在作出解释后作罢。侦探带走了一些登记表，并指示必须停止登记工作。
同日下午，选举办事处与公董局展开谈判。与此同时，法租界某知名人士向法国总领事解释了登记情况。随后，法国当局承认发生了误会。8月12日晚，被带至警察局的登记表副本归还给选举办事处。法国当局表示今后不再干涉，并承诺协助该项工作。
8月13日，法租界内的公民登记工作恢复。

August 24, 1936. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE ABOLITION OF THE PRACTICE OF TIPPING

At 3 p.m. yesterday, the Hotel Owners Association held a general meeting of representatives at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, to discuss the abolition of tipping. Wang Loong Chang (王龍章), representing the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters, Yuan Hung Chun (袁鴻鈞), representing the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and more than 200 persons, representing the Central (中央), the Nanking (南京), the Grand (東方), the Cha Loh (爵祿), the Cheng Chow (神州) Hotels (all located in the International Settlement) were present. Chen Ying Ta (陳潤達) and two others presided.

The opinion was unanimous that the section of the regulations governing the abolition of tipping which stipulates that no cash deposits are to be collected or demanded from employees and that tips voluntarily given by customers are to be handed over to the National Aviation Association as aviation contributions cannot be supported as it would affect the hotel trade and the livelihood of the employees.

The following resolutions were then passed:-

(1) That the Executive Committee of the Hotel Owners Association submit to the Tangpu, the Shanghai City Government, and the Bureau of Social Affairs a petition containing the general view of this meeting and the hardships of hotel owners.

(2) That Chang Tse Zung (張志誠) and several others be elected as representatives to the New Life Movement Acceleration Committee to make a detailed statement on the hardships of hotel owners.

Ta Mei Wan Pao published the following article on August 23 :-

THE REGISTRATION OF CITIZENS - HUT DWELLERS TO TAKE PART

Considering it the duty of all hut dwellers to register themselves as citizens of the Republic, the Hut Dwellers Federation has delegated representatives to the Shanghai First Special District Citizens Federation to apply for the registration of hut dwellers.

As a result, Chen Chun Yung (陳春榮) was appointed by the 39th and 47th branches of the Shanghai First Special District Citizens Federation to distribute, with the assistance of Wang Chi Tai (王其泰) and other executive members of the Hut Dwellers Federation, registration forms among the hut dwellers.

It is learned that most of the hut dwellers have filled in and returned the forms to the two branches of the Citizens Federation.

废除小费惯例

昨日下午3时，旅馆业主联合会在上海总商会举行代表全体会议，讨论废除小费事宜。代表上海特别区国民党党部的王龙章、代表上海总商会的袁鸿钧，以及代表中央饭店、南京饭店、东方饭店、爵禄饭店、神州饭店（均位于公共租界内）等200余人出席了会议。陈润达等二人主持了会议。

与会者一致意见认为，关于废除小费的规章中规定不得向雇员收取或索要现金押金，且顾客自愿给予的小费应上缴给中国航空建设协会作为航空捐款的条款无法得到支持，因为这将影响旅馆业和雇员的生计。

随后通过了以下决议：

(1) 由旅馆业主联合会执行委员会向塘浦、上海市政府和社会局提交请愿书，陈述本次会议的一般观点及旅馆业主的困境。

(2) 选举张志诚等人为新生活运动促进会代表，就旅馆业主的困境作详细陈述。

Subject The Election Office of the Shanghai Municipality Representatives
to the People's National Congress - activities.
Made by D. I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

The Election Office of the Shanghai Municipality
Representatives to the National People's Congress for the
registration of Chinese citizens throughout Shanghai inserted
an advertisement in to-day's Chinese Press, announcing that
August 26 has been fixed as the date for the registration
of those Chinese citizens who have not already registered
and that twenty one temporary registration offices have
been established for the convenience of residents of various
districts. A full translation of this notice is attached.
Four of these offices are located either in the
Settlement or on extra-Settlement roads. Their addresses
are as follows :-
4th Registration Office - 3rd District Kuomintang Headquarters,
Temple of the Queen of Heaven, North
Honan Road.
5th Registration Office - Chinese Ratepayers' Association,
59 Hongkong Road.
6th Registration Office - Shanghai Middle School, Kiaochow Road.
7th Registration Office - The Bei Teh Primary School, 492
Washing Road.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 25 AUG. 1936 (CRIME BRANCH)）

According to information from the Election Office, any
Chinese who fails to register will forfeit his civil rights,
and will not be eligible for election as a delegate to the
National People's Congress.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

Date August 22, 1936.

Subject Registration of Citizens in Shanghai

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [签名]

The campaign conducted by the Election Office of
the Shanghai Municipality Representatives to the National
People's Congress for the registration of Chinese citizens
throughout Shanghai, which started on August 18, was
officially concluded on August 19 and detailed statistics
showing the number of forms distributed and filled in are
in the course of compilation. According to information
from the Election Office, located at the City Government
Road, off Route Ghisi, the result of the campaign is
unsatisfactory owing to the fact that the period allowed
was too short in consideration of the vast area to be
covered, and also to the fact that a number of schools
failed to supply volunteers for the work when requested to
do so. It is learned that the Election Office will resume
the campaign by establishing registration centres at various
parts of Shanghai where those who have not received the
forms during the previous period should apply for registration.
The date for the second movement and the venues of these centres
will be decided in a few days and announced in the local
Chinese press and if possible, broadcasted from local radio
stations.

（印：DEPT GENERAL 22 AUG. 1936 CRIME BRANCH）

Made by D. I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

The registration of Chinese citizens, which is now
proceeding in Shanghai, is a preliminary to the election of
delegates to the National Congress to be held in November, 1936,
at Nanking. This registration is one of the important tasks
which the National Government formulated a long time ago and
is essential to the convention of the Nations' Congress as
outlined by the Kuomintang principles for the reconstruction of
China. It has been rendered necessary by the fact that China
lacks proper records of each individual citizen due to the
omission in the past of compiling vital statistics and keeping
a proper census of the population.

The Kuomintang principles provide the reconstruction
of China in three periods, namely :-
1st Period - Military operations.
2nd Period - Political Tutelage.
3rd Period - Constitutional Government.

The first period commenced in 1926 with the inauguration
of the anti-Northern Expedition by the Revolutionary Forces
from Canton and terminated with the occupation of North China
by the Expeditionary troops in 1929.

The second period followed in 1930 and terminated in
1935.

In 1936, China entered the period of Constitutional
Government.

The Kuomintang principles stipulate that during the
period of Political Tutelage, a complete census of the
population and surveys of districts should be taken, an
efficient police system should be organized, roads should be
constructed throughout the country, so that genuine local

呈报人 探员 施泽良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人 [签名]

目前在上海进行的中国公民登记，是将于1936年11月在南京召开的国民大会代表选举的预备工作。此次登记是国民政府很久以前制定的一项重要任务，对于按照国民党重建中国的原则召开国民大会至关重要。由于中国过去在编制 vital statistics（生命统计）和保持适当的人口普查方面存在疏漏，缺乏每位公民的适当记录，使得此次登记成为必要。

国民党原则规定重建中国分为三个时期，即：-
第一期 - 军政时期。
第二期 - 训政时期。
第三期 - 宪政时期。

第一期始于1926年，随着革命力量从广州发起北伐而开始，并于1929年北伐军占领华北而结束。

第二期随后于1930年开始，至1935年结束。

1936年，中国进入宪政时期。

国民党原则规定，在训政期间，应进行全面的人口普查和地区调查，组织高效的警察系统，在全国修建道路，以便真正的地方

more than half of the provinces in the country have established
local self-governments in all their districts, the period of
Constitutional Government would commence and a National Congress
would be assembled to decide on the adoption and promulgation

    Most of these stipulations were carried out by the
National Government during the period of Political Tutelage,
1930-1935. The first meeting of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang
held on December 4, 1935 after the 5th Plenary Session of the
Kuomintang in November, 1935, decided to convoke the National
Congress on November 12, 1936, from which date will commence
the period of Constitutional Government.
    Owing to the lack of proper statistics regarding each
individual citizen of the Republic of China, a registration
of all Chinese citizens is therefore necessary as a preliminary
to the Congress and at the same time to supplement previous
unreliable census statistics.
    This registration will entitle a citizen not only
to vote in the election of representatives to the National

1) Referendum - the right to pass laws or to vote on laws.
2) Initiative - the right to introduce or enact legislation
                direct by the people.
3) Repeal     - the right to annul any act.
4) Election   - the right to vote and to be voted for.

    这些规定中的大部分由国民政府在1930-1935年的训政期间执行。1935年11月国民党五中全会之后，国民党中央执行委员会于1935年12月4日召开的第一次会议决定于1936年11月12日召开国民大会，从该日起将开始宪政时期。
    由于缺乏关于中华民国每位公民的适当统计数据，因此作为大会的预备工作，对所有中国公民进行登记是必要的，同时也为了补充先前不可靠的人口普查统计数据。
    此次登记不仅使公民有权在国民大会代表选举中投票，还享有以下重要权利：-
1) 复决权 - 通过法律或对法律进行投票的权利。
2) 创制权 - 人民直接提出或制定立法的权利。
3) 罢免权 - 废除任何法案的权利。
4) 选举权 - 投票和被选举的权利。

4) Those who have been prohibited from managing property.

In view of Item No.6, it is obvious that the

proper registration of opium smokers has first been taken.
The prolonged negotiations with the authorities of the
Settlement over the enforcement of the anti-opium regulations
in the Settlements and the question of registration of opium
smokers in the Settlements have delayed the registration of
citizens up to the present time.
By means of this registration, the National Government

administrative laws, such as the collection of an income tax,

Subject Registration of Citizens in the International Settlement

Made by D. I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

The registration of Chinese citizens in the Inter-
national Settlement commenced at 8 a.m. August 18, with 80
persons in groups, of the 4th District Election Office
distributing registration forms to residents in Hongkew,
Dixwell Road, Kashing Road, Wayside, Yulin Road and Yangtszepoo
Districts, and 600 persons including 50 boyscouts and 400
primary school students of the 3rd District Election Office
operating in West Hongkew, Central, Louza, Chengtu Road,
Sinsa, Bubbling Well, Gordon Road and Pootoo Road Districts.
Owing to the extensive area and the small number of volunteers,
the work of distributing and collecting the registration
forms will not be completed within two days, August 18 and 19.
According to a notice published in the local Chinese
press on August 16 by the Election Office of the Shanghai
Municipality Representatives to the National People's Congress,
the task of distributing and collecting registration forms
should be completed within two days, August 18 and 19, but
it is anticipated the work will take longer.
The 3rd District Election Office is located in the
3rd District Kuomintang Headquarters, Temple of the Queen of
Heaven, North Honan Road, while the 4th District Election
Office is established in the premises of the 4th District
Kuomintang, 43 Tien Doong Li, Tien Doong Road, Chapei.
The registration of citizens in Nantao also commenced
on August 18. 150 persons including boyscouts, members of
Bureau of Public Safety, Merchant Volunteer Corps and
of the local Tangpu assisted in the distribution of registration
forms.

主题：国际租界内公民登记

由 侦探督察 Sih Tse-liang（施子良） 制作 转呈 [签名]

国际租界内的中国公民登记工作于8月18日上午8时开始，第四区选举办事处派出80人组成小组，向虹口、狄思威路（Dixwell Road）、嘉善路（Kashing Road）、韦尔斯利路（Wayside）、榆林路和杨树浦区的居民分发登记表；第三区选举办事处派出包括50名童子军和400名小学生在内的600人，在西虹口、中央、老闸、成都路、新闸、静安寺、戈登路和普陀路地区开展工作。由于地域广阔且志愿者人数较少，分发和收集登记表的工作无法在8月18日和19日这两天内完成。根据上海市国民大会代表选举办事处于8月16日在当地中文报刊上发布的通知，分发和收集登记表的任务应在8月18日和19日这两天内完成，但预计此项工作将耗时更长。

第三区选举办事处位于河南北路天后宫内的国民党第三区党部，而第四区选举办事处设在闸北天通庵路天通里43号的国民党第四区党部 premises 内。

南市的公民登记也于8月18日开始。包括童子军、公安局成员、商团义勇队成员以及当地塘浦路人员在内的150人协助分发登记表。

SHANGHAI DIVIDED
INTO 17 DISTRICTS

Groups Are Appointed
To Conduct Pledging
Procedures

Plans to conduct a city-wide citizenship registration and oath-taking in preparation of the forthcoming National People's Congress were announced in an order promulgated yesterday by the City Government of Greater Shanghai. According to the program, Shanghai will be divided into 17 districts, in addition to the two special districts consisting the International Settlement and the French Concession. To facilitate the gigantic enterprise, several civic associations have been named to assist the municipal officials in enforcing the plans.

Groups Appointed

The groups appointed to officiate are the city and the district Kuomintang offices, the Board of Management of the Boy Scout Troop of Shanghai, the Executive Committee of the Volunteer Corps, the Greater Shanghai Farmers' Union and the Greater Shanghai General Labor Union. In addition, the Bureau of Public Safety and the Bureau of Education will also help to conduct the registration and pledging procedures.

By complying with the registration formalities and after taking the citizenship pledge, Chinese people here will receive the four primary rights of election, referendum, recall, and initiative.

Civic groups as well as the National People's Congress Election Office of Greater Shanghai will endeavor to distribute registration forms to all Chinese residents three years old who are over the age of... To eliminate any error in the collection of the attributes of the registered... the 17 districts and the...

are asked to visit various assigned oath-taking centers, where a scrutineer will check over the papers before the pledge is administered.

A list of those who have properly executed their oaths will be made public in various districts, and persons who failed to register will be given another day to record their names.

With the date of the Congress drawing near, the office in charge of election affairs here has decided to convene a conference of various local public bodies at the City Government building, Civic Center, next Wednesday, August 12.

Translation of an advertisement published on August 16, 1936,
in the Sin Wan Pao by the Election Office of the Shanghai
Municipality Representatives to the National People's Congress.

Circular Notice No.9

August 18 and 19 have been designated by the Election
Office as the dates for the registration of citizens in the
Municipality of Shanghai. According to the program we drawn up,
the first day will be devoted to the distribution of registration
and oath-taking forms and the second day to the collection of
registration forms (oath-taking forms are not collected.)

Citizens over the age of 20 in the Municipality must
fill in the registration forms. (The column "To what professional
organization do you belong" can be left unfilled if you do not
belong to any organization. If you have joined any organization,
you must fill in the column in order to enable you to take part
in the election of professional organizations.) Citizens must
hand the registration forms to collectors on the following
day and retain the oath-taking forms to be used on the oath-
taking day which will be announced publicly.

The registration of citizens is a preliminary to the
election of representatives. Citizens who have not been
registered and have not taken an oath are not entitled to the
right to elect or to be elected as representatives.

It is to be noted that no fees whatever are collected
from citizens in connection with the registration.

Wu Te-chen
Supervisor

1936年8月16日由上海市国民大会代表选举办事处在《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）上刊登的广告译文。

第九号通告

选举办事处指定8月18日和19日为上海市公民登记日期。根据我们制定的计划，第一天用于分发登记和宣誓表格，第二天用于收集登记表（不收集宣誓表）。

本市年满20岁的公民必须填写登记表。（“所属职业团体”一栏，如不属于任何团体可留空。如已加入任何团体，必须填写此栏，以便参加职业团体的选举。）公民必须在次日将登记表交给收集员，并保留宣誓表，以备在日后公开宣布的宣誓日使用。

公民登记是代表选举的前奏。未登记且未宣誓的公民无权选举或被选为代表。

需要注意的是，公民登记不收取任何费用。

吴铁城
总监

江苏省政府主席陈果夫于8月12日晚10时50分从南京抵达上海。

上海市国民大会代表选举办事处
——会议

在上海市国民大会代表选举办事处的主持下，于8月12日上午10时在吉司赫路（Route Ghisi）旁市政府路107号举行会议，出席者包括当地党部、上海市政府、公安局、教育局、总工会及中国童子军委员会的代表，由当地党部委员吴开先主持。

通过以下决议：

1. 为便利市民登记，划定南市为第一区；法租界为第二区；公共租界为第三区；东教堂区为第四区；浦东为第五区；西教堂区为第六区；江湾为第七区；吴淞为第八区；龙华为第九区；北新泾为第十区；陈行（Chenju）为第十一区。

2. 请公安局为各分区选举办事处提供警力保护。

3. 选定8月16日为开始市民登记的日期。

Dated 11th August, 1936.

People's Congress: Elections.

The City Government is now making preparations for the
election of delegates from this city to the forthcoming People's
Congress. The following organizations have been deputized with
the work of registration of citizens in the Settlement:-
The District Kuomintang Headquarters,
The District Kuomintang Branch Headquarters,
The Chinese Ratepayers' Association,
The First Special District Citizens' Federation, and
The Shanghai Board of Directors of the Chinese Boy Scouts.
Please take note and notify the department concerned.

(chopped)
Yu Hung-chun,
Chief Secretary.

国民大会：选举。

市政府现正筹备本市出席即将召开的国民大会代表的选举工作。下列组织已被委派负责租界内的市民登记工作：

第一特区市民联合会，以及

俞鸿钧，

August 14, 1936.

Election Office of the Shanghai Municipality Representatives
to the National People's Congress - proposed activities in
the Settlement

In accordance with the decision of the Election Office of
the Shanghai Municipality Representatives to the National People's
Congress, which was reached on August 12, a registration of local
citizens will be taken commencing from August 18, 1936. To
facilitate the work of registration, Shanghai is divided into
eleven districts; the International Settlement is divided into
two districts, namely:

The 3rd District: comprising West Hongkew, Central, LOuza,
Changtu Road, Sinza, Bubbling Well,
Gordon Road, Pootoo Road Districts.

The 4th District: comprising Hongkew, Dixwell Road, Kashing
Road, Wayside, Yulin Road and Yangtszepoo
Districts.

The office of the 3rd District has been established in the
office of the 3rd District Kuomintang, Temple of Queen of Heaven,
North Honan Road, while the headquarters of the 4th District has
been established in the office of the 4th District Kuomintang,
Chapei.

The office of the 3rd District is in charge of one named
Koo Chi-wu (顧繼武), principal of the Tsing Nien Middle School,
553 Avenue Joffre, who is assisted by Ling Shien-wen (凌憲文),
member of the Standing Committee of the 3rd. District Kuomintang,
and some eight clerks who are attending to the clerical work
pertaining to registration. Arrangements are being made to secure
the services of 200 Chinese boyscouts and 200 volunteers from
local public bodies and schools for the purpose of distributing
registration forms to Chinese residents of the Settlement.

The registration will formally commence on August 16, and
from this date residents of the Settlement may go to the office
in the Temple of Queen of Heaven, North Honan Road, to register.
The 200 boyscouts and the 200 volunteers will be formed into groups

1936年8月14日。

上海市国民大会代表选举办事处——拟在租界开展的活动

根据上海市国民大会代表选举办事处于8月12日作出的决定，将于1936年8月18日开始进行本地市民登记。为便利登记工作，上海划分为十一个区；公共租界划分为两个区，即：

第三区：包括虹口西区、中区、老闸、长涂路、新闸、静安寺、戈登路、普陀路各区。

第四区：包括虹口、狄思威路、嘉善路、韦尔斯利路（Wayside）、榆林路及杨树浦区。

第三区办事处已设在北河南路天后宫内的第三区国民党党部办公室，而第四区总部则设在闸北第四区国民党党部办公室。

第三区办事处由顾继武负责，他是位于霞飞路553号的青年中学校长，协助他的是第三区国民党党部常务委员凌宪文，以及约八名处理登记文书工作的职员。目前正在安排征募200名中国童子军和200名来自当地公共团体及学校的志愿者，以便向租界内的中国居民分发登记表。

登记工作将于8月16日正式开始，从该日起，租界居民可前往北河南路天后宫的办事处进行登记。这200名童子军和200名志愿者将编成小组，

page_data.en:
- 2 -

consisting of four or five persons each who will pay house to house
visits in the Settlement between August 18 to 25 and distribute
copies of a registration form ( a sample attached herewith with
translation). The visitors may fill in the forms on behalf of
residents or residents may fill the forms themselves and submit
them not later than November 12 to registration-form reception
boxes to be installed by the office at various places in the area
of the 3rd District. It is learned that in all seven boxes will be
installed, but the location of these boxes has not yet been decided.
With regard to the office of the 4th District, located in
the 4th District Kuomintang, Lane 156, No.43 Tiendong Road, Chapei,
the person in charge is one named Sung Ting (沈井), member of
the Standing Committee of the 4th District Kuomintang, who is
assisted by ten clerks, all members of the Kuomintang. According
to the plans of the Office, the registration will commence on
about August 18, in the 4th District, which consists of the area
lying to the east of North Honan Road and north of the Soochow Road
including Yangtsepoo. A definite working in effecting the registra-
tion has not yet been decided upon, but arrangements are being made
to secure the cooperation of various branches of the 1st Special
District Citizens' Federation in the Eastern District and boyscouts
of various schools in that locality in forming groups for the purpose
of paying house to house visits and distributing and collecting
registration forms.

- 2 -

每组四至五人，于8月18日至25日期间在租界内挨户访问，并分发登记表副本（附样本及译文）。访问员可代居民填写表格，或由居民自行填写，并于11月12日前提交至办事处在第三区范围内各处设置的登记表接收箱。据悉共将设置七个接收箱，但这些箱子的具体位置尚未确定。至于设在闸北天潼路43弄156号第四区国民党党部的第四区办事处，负责人是第四区国民党党部常务委员沈井（Sung Ting），由十名均为国民党党员的职员协助。根据办事处的计划，第四区（包括北河南路以东、苏州河以北的区域，含杨树浦）的登记工作将于8月18日左右开始。实施登记的具体工作方案尚未确定，但正在安排争取东区第一特区市民联合会各分会及该地区各学校童子军的合作，组成小组，以便进行挨户访问，分发并收集登记表。
